rows.en: 02  Support Nadesico B
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Attention! I am the commander of <book(10)>Londo Bell<endbook()>, <color(4)>Kouichiro Misumaru<ce()>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Well done on the last operation. I expect the same from you in the missions ahead.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>The <color(5)>unidentified life-forms<ce()> we are investigating continue to appear around the world<thumbnail(153)>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>We know they emerge from meteorites that arrive from beyond the atmosphere.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>They also calcify after a certain time. This has prevented us from capturing any.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)><book(9)>Federation<endbook()> Headquarters views this as a grave situation and has made it our highest priority.

<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Our <book(10)>Londo Bell<endbook()> force<thumbnail(154)> will become a special task force, joined by Lt. Cmdr. <color(4)>Ruri Hoshino<ce()> and the <book(20)>Nadesico B<endbook()>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Understand the gravity of this situation. I am counting on you!
<thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Next, I have something to say to <color(4)>Barrel Orland<ce()>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Your father, the former <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> vice-minister, helped me in the past. Both your parents have been confirmed safe.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I also hear you did well as a temporary pilot in the last operation. Keep up the good work.
<operator(30000,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel Orland<ce()>. It was an emergency, but I am sorry we got you involved.
<operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>We will continue our investigation under Commander-in-Chief <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()>.
<operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>Under military regulations, a special order from the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> forces requires you to remain with us.
<operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>For now, you will take part in operations as the test pilot of the <color(4)>Exbrau<ce()><thumbnail(152)>.
<operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>I will explain the details after the briefing.
<thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>We must act at once. The <book(20)>Nadesico B<endbook()><thumbnail(155)>, which is due to join us, faces an emergency.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>It is battling a <book(35)>Zentradi<endbook()> <color(5)>terrorist unit<ce()> made up of former military personnel that attacked it.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Head to the combat zone immediately and support the <book(20)>Nadesico B<endbook()>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Unable to adapt to life on Earth, some <book(35)>Zentradi<endbook()> turn to terrorism. This is a serious problem for the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Their attacks used to be small in scale, but their reach is growing. Everyone, proceed with caution.

<thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>One more point. The <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> is selecting its next <book(34)>Valkyrie<endbook()> under <book(85)>Project Super Nova<endbook()><thumbnail(157)>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>As part of the trials, two <book(34)>Valkyries<endbook()> are currently supporting the <book(20)>Nadesico B<endbook()>.
<thumbdown()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Work with them to eliminate the <color(5)>enemy forces<ce()>. That is all.
Zentradi
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><move(1,2,13)>We will strike the <marker(1,2,13,0)><color(5)>enemy forces<ce()> deployed in the operation area.<move(2,2,13)>

<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><move(1,12,1)>Only attack the <marker(22,12,1,0)><color(5)>targets<ce()><move(1,8,1)> among the <color(5)>enemy <marker(22,8,1,0)>forces<ce()>.<move(1,10,10)> You do not need to fight <marker(22,10,10,0)>them all.<move(2,10,10)><picture(52,30,7,0)><refer(30,7,12,1)>

<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Find the <color(5)>targets<ce()> on your radar.<marker(20,2,2,0)><marker(20,7,5,0)><marker(20,10,5,0)><marker(20,13,6,0)><marker(20,1,9,0)><marker(20,4,10,0)><marker(20,7,12,0)> They appear as <color(6)>flashing markers<ce()>.

<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><move(1,8,9)>The <book(20)>Nadesico B<endbook()><marker(3,8,9,0)> is badly worn down from earlier fighting.<move(2,8,9)><picture(123,30,14,0)><refer(30,14,8,9)> It will launch <book(6)>drones<endbook()> to provide support.

<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>They can hold the enemy off, but <move(1,7,8)>if the <book(6)>drones<endbook()><marker(5,5,6,0)> are destroyed<move(2,7,8)><picture(53,2,7,0)><refer(2,7,5,6)>, the <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> will be in danger.

<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>If the <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> is <color(6)>sunk, we lose<ce()>.<marker(48,7,7,0)><marker(48,10,7,0)><marker(32,12,7,1)><marker(48,12,3,0)><marker(48,8,3,0)> Give priority to defending the <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> when the situation calls for it.
<delpic(30,7,1)><enemylist()><operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>All right. Move out.
